{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()

print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Final dataset after cleaning
data_final = data_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

print(f'Final number of orders after cleaning: {len(data_final)}')

# Check the channel distribution
distribution = data_final['channel'].value_counts()
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(distribution)

# Check customer segment distribution
segment_dist = data_final['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(segment_dist)

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by channel:')
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Check mean revenue by channel
mean_revenue_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print('\nMean revenue by channel:')
print(mean_revenue_by_channel)

# Final summary
print(f'\nFinal dataset: {len(data_final)} orders')"}
